description: An online store for a brand or a shop with many departments: two home pages (a department store with a big search, or a brand with a full-bleed photograph), shop pages with filters in the address bar, product pages with colors, sizes, sold-out sizes, a size guide, reviews and pairs-well-with, a cart drawer with free-shipping progress, one-page checkout with discount codes, taxes and gift cards, order confirmation, account and orders, track an order, gift cards, saved items, search with suggestions, a journal, about, help and contact. // shipping, returns, taxes, codes), the departments, 20 products with their colors, sizes, stock and
// copy, reviews, the journal, the help pages and a sample customer. Swap them for yours; every page
// reads from this file. Photos are keys into PHOTOS (assets.ts).
// HOME picks the home page and the look of every page: "department" (a big search, departments and
// rows of products, for a store with many lines) or "brand" (a full-bleed photograph, a serif masthead
// and stories, for a brand that makes its own things).

type Props = {
  /** The path under the base: [] is the home page, ["products", "merino-crew-sweater"] a product. */
  path?: string[]
  /** Where the store lives, e.g. "/store". */
  base: string
  /** Which home it opens on, and the look of every page; HOME in data.ts by default. */
  variant?: Variant
  /** The installed DressCode theme's id. */
  theme?: string
  /** Pop's ink outlines (dresscode.layout.brutal). */
  brutal?: boolean
}

function view(route: Route, base: string, variant: Variant) {
  const p = { base, variant }
  switch (route.page) {
    case "home":
      return variant === "brand" ? <BrandHome base={base} /> : <DepartmentHome base={base} />
    case "shop":
      return <ShopPage {...p} id={route.id} />
    case "product":
      return <ProductPage {...p} slug={route.slug} />
    case "search":
      return <SearchPage {...p} />
    case "cart":
      return <CartPage {...p} />
    case "checkout":
      return <CheckoutPage {...p} />
    case "confirmation":
      return <ConfirmationPage {...p} />
    case "saved":
      return <SavedPage {...p} />
    case "account":
      return <AccountPage {...p} />
    case "sign-in":
      return <SignInPage {...p} />
    case "order":
      return <OrderPage {...p} number={route.number} />
    case "track":
      return <TrackPage {...p} />
    case "gift-cards":
      return <GiftCardsPage {...p} />
    case "journal":
      return <JournalPage {...p} />
    case "post":
      return <PostPage {...p} slug={route.slug} />
    case "about":
      return <AboutPage {...p} />
    case "help":
      return <HelpPage {...p} />
    case "contact":
      return <ContactPage {...p} />
    case "not-found":
      return <NotFoundPage {...p} />
  }
}

export function EcommerceSite({ path, base, variant = HOME, theme, brutal }: Props) {
  const route = resolve(path) ?? { page: "not-found" }
  return (
    <EcommerceRoot theme={theme} brutal={brutal}>
      {view(route, base, variant)}
    </EcommerceRoot>
  )
}

/** The page's <title> and description, for generateMetadata. */
export function ecommerceMetadata(path?: string[]): Metadata {
  const { title, description } = pageMeta(resolve(path))
  return { title, description }
}

E-commerce store: the pages are in components/ecommerce/ and the routes are /store, /store/shop, /store/products/<product>, /store/checkout and so on.
Make it yours in components/ecommerce/data.ts: the brand, the store's rules (shipping, returns, codes, taxes), departments, products, reviews and journal, and HOME ("department" or "brand").
The cart, saved items and orders live in the browser (store.ts); payment is a hook (placeOrder in checkout.tsx) for Stripe, Shopify or your own API.
The sample photographs load from dresscodeui.com; point the keys in components/ecommerce/assets.ts at your own photos.
It reads lib/dresscode-theme.ts, so install a DressCode theme first (any of the nine), e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
Built on shadcn/ui with Base UI (components.json style base-*): the menus and sheet use Base UI's render prop.
